audit_resolution_summary.R01_frozen_replay_syntax: Resolved in reproduce_release.py (vectorized returns and TRANS_ arm normalization)

audit_resolution_summary.R08_sharpe_win_rate_definitions: Resolved: documented population std (ddof=0) and daily session win rate
